# Testing the code base against the Meilisearch pre-releases
name: Pre-Release Tests

# Will only run for PRs and pushes to bump-meilisearch-v*
on:
  push:
    branches: [bump-meilisearch-v*]
  pull_request:
    branches: [bump-meilisearch-v*]

jobs:
  integration_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: integration-tests
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          cache: yarn
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn
      - name: Launch tests
        run: yarn test
  playground_build_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: playground-build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          cache: yarn
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn --dev && yarn --cwd ./playground
      - name: Build Strapi playground
        run: yarn playground:build
  style_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: style-check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          cache: yarn
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn --dev
      - name: Run style check
        run: yarn style
      - name: Yaml Style
        uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@v3
        with:
          config_file: .yamllint.yml

name: Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

jobs:
  unit_tests:
    # Will not run if the event is a PR to bump-meilisearch-v* (so a pre-release PR)
    # Will still run for each push to bump-meilisearch-v*
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !startsWith(github.base_ref, 'bump-meilisearch-v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: unit-tests
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node + deps
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-and-deps
        with:
          cache-playground: "false"
      - name: Launch tests
        run: yarn test

  integration_tests:
    name: integration-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    services:
      meilisearch:
        image: getmeili/meilisearch-enterprise:latest
        env:
          MEILI_MASTER_KEY: "masterKey"
          MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS: "true"
        ports:
          - "7700:7700"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node + deps (root + playground)
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-and-deps
        with:
          cache-playground: "true"
      - name: Build and link plugin
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-and-link-plugin
      - name: Seed playground database
        run: |
          mkdir -p playground/.tmp
          yarn playground:setup
      - name: Build Strapi playground
        run: yarn playground:build
      - name: Start Strapi playground
        run: |
          cd playground
          yarn start &
          STRAPI_PID=$!
          echo "STRAPI_PID=$STRAPI_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          MEILISEARCH_HOST: http://localhost:7700
          MEILISEARCH_API_KEY: masterKey
          MEILI_RELATIONS_TEST: "1"
      - name: Wait for Strapi to be ready
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for Strapi to be ready..."
          for i in {1..60}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:1337/_health > /dev/null; then
              echo "Strapi is ready!"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Attempt $i: Strapi not ready yet, waiting..."
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Timeout waiting for Strapi to start"
          exit 1
      - name: Run Meilisearch relations integration test
        run: yarn test:integrations
        env:
          MEILISEARCH_HOST: http://localhost:7700
          MEILISEARCH_API_KEY: masterKey
      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ ! -z "$STRAPI_PID" ]; then
            kill $STRAPI_PID || true
          fi
  playground_build_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: playground-build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node + deps (root + playground)
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-and-deps
        with:
          cache-playground: "true"
      - name: Build Strapi playground
        run: yarn playground:build
  linter_check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: style-check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node + deps
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-and-deps
        with:
          cache-playground: "false"
      - name: Run style check
        run: yarn style
      - name: Yaml Style
        uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@v3
        with:
          config_file: .yamllint.yml

name: Beta tests
